mapper.sql: id, user_id, status, start_date, end_date, notes, diagnosis, reminder_methods, conflicts, activated_at, paused_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medication_plan (user_id, status, start_date, end_date, notes, diagnosis, reminder_methods, conflicts) VALUES (#{userId}, #{status}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{notes}, #{diagnosis}, #{reminderMethods}, #{conflicts})
mapper.update: UPDATE medication_plan p SET p.status = CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reminder r WHERE r.plan_id = p.id AND r.status <> 'TAKEN') THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'EXPIRED' END WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.end_date < CURDATE()
